Handmade Leather Wallets

Why full-grain leather

Full-grain leather keeps the outermost layer of the hide intact, which is the densest and most durable part. It resists tearing, develops a patina instead of flaking, and outlasts every corrected-grain alternative on the market by a wide margin under daily use in a back pocket.

How we cut it

Each panel is cut by hand from a single hide so the grain runs continuously across the wallet, then edge-burnished and saddle-stitched with waxed linen thread that will not unravel when a single stitch fails.

The lifetime guarantee

If a wallet fails under normal use we repair or replace it, for as long as you own it. That has been the policy since the first year and it will not change, because a leather good that cannot be repaired is disposable.
